title: At work
focus: 会议、项目、客户、领导、合作、汇报、截止日期、效率
body:
# At work

Mainland office vocabulary: meetings, projects, clients, and the boss.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 会议 | huìyì | meeting (formal noun) | gathering to discuss → meeting |
| 项目 | xiàngmù | project (at work) | item on the list → project |
| 客户 | kèhù | client (business customer) | guest household → client |
| 领导 | lǐngdǎo | the higher-ups / one's superior (mainland workplace word) | lead and guide → the boss |
| 合作 | hézuò | to cooperate / work together (between people or companies) | work joined together |
| 汇报 | huìbào | to report (to a superior, on progress) | gather it up, report upward |
| 截止日期 | jiézhǐ rìqī | deadline | cut-off-stop date → deadline |
| 效率 | xiàolǜ | efficiency | rate of results → efficiency |

## Which word?

**会议 vs 开会.** 开会 is the everyday verb (我在开会). 会议 is the noun (明天的会议, 会议室).

## Sentences

- 明天的会议我来安排。 míngtiān de huìyì wǒ lái ānpái: I'll organise tomorrow's meeting.
- 这个项目我负责，每周跟领导汇报。 zhège xiàngmù wǒ fùzé, měi zhōu gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào: I'm in charge of this project and report to the boss every week.
- 客户突然取消了合作。 kèhù tūrán qǔxiāo le hézuò: The client suddenly pulled out of the partnership.
- 我得先跟领导汇报一下情况。 wǒ děi xiān gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào yíxià qíngkuàng: I need to brief my boss on the situation first.
- 截止日期是周五，估计来不及了。 jiézhǐ rìqī shì zhōuwǔ, gūjì láibují le: The deadline is Friday. I doubt we'll make it.
- 会议太多，效率反而更低了。 huìyì tài duō, xiàolǜ fǎn'ér gèng dī le: There are so many meetings that we're actually less efficient.
- 领导建议我们跟这个客户合作。 lǐngdǎo jiànyì wǒmen gēn zhège kèhù hézuò: The boss suggested we work with this client.
- 项目的截止日期又推迟了。 xiàngmù de jiézhǐ rìqī yòu tuīchí le: The project deadline has been pushed back again.

cards.Example: 下午三点有个会议。 xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǒu ge huìyì: There's a meeting at three this afternoon
cards.Notes: 会 huì meet, gather (开会, 晚会) + 议 yì discuss, 讠 speech (建议, 议论) = a gathering to discuss, so a meeting. 开会 is the everyday verb; 会议 is the noun, more formal: 参加会议, 会议室.

cards.Example: 这个项目下个月要交。 zhège xiàngmù xià ge yuè yào jiāo: This project is due next month
cards.Notes: 项 xiàng item; originally nape of the neck, 页 head (项链 necklace) + 目 mù eye; item in a list (节目, 题目) = an item on the list, so a project. Also 'item / event': 比赛项目 = sporting events.

cards.Example: 客户对这个方案不太满意。 kèhù duì zhège fāng'àn bú tài mǎnyì: The client isn't very happy with this proposal
cards.Notes: 客 kè guest (客人) + 户 hù household; originally a one-leaf door (窗户, 户口) = a guest household, a client account. 客户 = business client; 顾客 = shop customer.

cards.English: the higher-ups / one's superior (mainland workplace word)
cards.Example: 这事得问问领导。 zhè shì děi wènwen lǐngdǎo: We'll have to ask the higher-ups about this
cards.Notes: 领 lǐng lead; collar (领子, 带领) + 导 dǎo guide (导游 tour guide, 导演 director) = lead and guide, so the higher-ups. Mainland offices say 领导 more than 老板 for one's superior.

cards.English: to cooperate / work together (between people or companies)
cards.Example: 希望以后有机会多合作。 xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì duō hézuò: Hope we get to work together more in future
cards.Notes: 合 hé join, combine (合适, 合唱) + 作 zuò do, work (工作, 作业) = work joined together, so cooperate. 合作愉快! = 'Here's to a good partnership!'

cards.English: to report (to a superior, on progress)
cards.Example: 我得跟领导汇报一下进度。 wǒ děi gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào yíxià jìndù: I need to report on progress to my boss
cards.Notes: 汇 huì converge, collect, 氵 water: streams flowing together (汇合) + 报 bào report (报告, 报纸) = gather it up and report, so report upward on progress. vs 报告 = a written report or formal announcement.

cards.Example: 截止日期是这周五。 jiézhǐ rìqī shì zhè zhōuwǔ: The deadline is this Friday
cards.Notes: 截 jié cut off (截图 screenshot) + 止 zhǐ stop (停止, 禁止) = cut off and stop; + 日期 date = the cutoff date, a deadline. Spoken often just 截止 / 最晚: 周五截止.

cards.Example: 这样做效率太低了。 zhèyàng zuò xiàolǜ tài dī le: Doing it this way is too inefficient
cards.Notes: 效 xiào effect, result (效果, 有效) + 率 lǜ rate (利率, 汇率) = rate of results, so efficiency. 效率高 / 效率低 = efficient / inefficient.

cards.Pinyin: míngtiān de huìyì wǒ lái ānpái.
cards.Notes: 会议 (L6) + 安排 (L5). 我来 + verb = 'I'll take care of it'.

cards.English: I'm in charge of this project and report to the boss every week.
cards.Hanzi: 这个项目我负责，每周跟领导汇报。
cards.Pinyin: zhège xiàngmù wǒ fùzé, měi zhōu gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào.
cards.Notes: 项目 (L6) + 领导 (L6) + 汇报 (L6) + 负责 (L4).

cards.English: The client suddenly pulled out of the partnership.
cards.Notes: 客户 (L6) + 合作 (L6) + 取消 (L5).

cards.English: I need to brief my boss on the situation first.
cards.Hanzi: 我得先跟领导汇报一下情况。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ děi xiān gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào yíxià qíngkuàng.
cards.Notes: 领导 (L6) + 汇报 (L6) + 情况 (L2). 跟 someone 汇报 = report to someone.

cards.English: The deadline is Friday. I doubt we'll make it.
cards.Hanzi: 截止日期是周五，估计来不及了。
cards.Pinyin: jiézhǐ rìqī shì zhōuwǔ, gūjì láibují le.
cards.Notes: 截止日期 (L6) + 估计 (L3) + 来不及 (L5).

cards.English: There are so many meetings that we're actually less efficient.
cards.Hanzi: 会议太多，效率反而更低了。
cards.Pinyin: huìyì tài duō, xiàolǜ fǎn'ér gèng dī le.
cards.Notes: 会议 (L6) + 效率 (L6) + 反而 (L2).

cards.English: The boss suggested we work with this client.
cards.Hanzi: 领导建议我们跟这个客户合作。
cards.Pinyin: lǐngdǎo jiànyì wǒmen gēn zhège kèhù hézuò.
cards.Notes: 领导 (L6) + 客户 (L6) + 合作 (L6) + 建议 (L3).

cards.English: The project deadline has been pushed back again.
cards.Hanzi: 项目的截止日期又推迟了。
cards.Pinyin: xiàngmù de jiézhǐ rìqī yòu tuīchí le.
cards.Notes: 项目 (L6) + 截止日期 (L6) + 推迟 (L5). 又 = again (already happened).
